name: Minimal Mono
signature: Concrete grey page, lowercase mono headings, almost no decoration, one cobalt link color.
bestFor: anyone with a phone number and few words

contrast.note: Light theme. Cobalt is safe as link text on both backgrounds. White on cobalt passes AA for the one button.

type.eyebrow: none; use a plain lowercase label in muted color

motion.rule: Nearly still: elements fade in over 400ms with no movement and no stagger, and the header gains a hairline when you scroll.

hero.layout: No photo above the fold: one lowercase mono sentence stating what the business does and where, followed by the phone number as a very large link. A single photo appears below, in grayscale, with 960px max width.
hero.photo: Optional: one real photo below the fold; grayscale by CSS filter.

background: Flat concrete grey, no textures. 1px ink hairlines at 20% opacity between sections. Whitespace does the work; the spacing scale is wider than every other pack.

button.shape: Rectangle, 0 radius, 48px tall; or a plain underlined text link.
button.fill: One accent-filled button per page with a white label; everything else is an underlined link.
button.label: Mono, weight 700, lowercase.
button.hover: Underline thickens from 1px to 3px; fill does not change.

banned: more than two type sizes in a section
more than one icon per section
color other than accent for links and the single button
